title: 美国初请失业金人数人数稳定，美联储为何更担心通胀？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Well, John, the foolish consistency of little minds is back again, 215,000 jobless claims
segments.zh: 约翰，失业金申领人数再次稳定在21.5万，

segments.en: were filed last week. That's almost exactly the same as the week before, revised up to 217,000, continuing claims,
segments.zh: 与前一周几乎持平，前值上修至21.7万。续领失业金人数为181.4万，

segments.en: 1,814,000, that is just a tiny bit higher than 1,806,000 the week before on a revised basis.
segments.zh: 略高于前一周修正后的180.6万。

segments.en: So basically, the Fed has told us in the minutes that they are sort of certain that the labor market is relatively steady at this point.
segments.zh: 美联储会议纪要显示，他们基本确信劳动力市场目前相对稳定。

segments.en: It is inflation that worries them, and the jobless claims keep that worry front and center in the sense that there doesn't seem to be a problem in the labor market at the moment.
segments.zh: 通胀才是他们担心的，而失业金数据让这一担忧持续，因为劳动力市场目前似乎没有问题。
